reviewer: agent scenario and actual native-frame review; not a human usability study
checks: Shared smooth typography and essential labels remain readable in compact, ordinary, 150% and physical 4K gallery captures
Light/dark/high-contrast state captures and independent contrast arithmetic pass; disabled control has no registered hit target
Real pointer text entry, shifted capitals/punctuation and Backspace, semantic text-field focus and F1/escape help are verified independently
Normal, selected, unavailable and focused surfaces have distinct states; no added permanent buffer or idle repaint was observed
limits: Later desktop/window/Start/Files/setup refinements and full M13.12 regression are separate stages
Production website behavior requires its own live browser and publication receipts

product_review.clarity: The Interface preview heading, descriptive text and named Back to System action identify the current task.
product_review.convenience: The gallery opens from ordinary Start search and System; pointer editing, Backspace and F1/Escape use normal input.
product_review.user_friendliness: The preview states that it does not write files/preferences; unavailable controls cannot be activated.
product_review.graphic_quality: Shared smooth typography, aligned controls and distinct light/dark/high-contrast surfaces were reviewed in actual native frames.
product_review.readability: Essential labels fit compact, ordinary, 150% and actual 4K 200% views; the shifted-input result and focus help remain readable.
